summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (56/123)

data.turoyo: <...> Hano hedika kmamte i bardiš du ḥalwo, kmaḥatla ʕal i nuro w ksoyəm nuro taḥta, kfoyər u ḥalwawo kule, kqoləb, lo ḥarule. <...>
data.translation: <...> Er holt sacht den Milchtopf und stellt ihn aufs Feuer. Er macht Feuer darunter, an und die ganze Milch kocht über und verdampft; er kümmert sich nicht darum. <...>

rationale: Establishes the missing Infectum box for existing sense 1 with overt milk and heating context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (56/123)

data.turoyo: <...> Kroṯəḥ u ḥalwo w malik ava kale ksoyəm nuro ṭahṭe, u ḥalwo kqoləb, fayər kule, yaqiḏo i bardiš.
data.translation: <...> Die Milch kocht und er - möge dein Haus gedeihen! - macht Feuer darunter; er paßt nicht auf, die ganze Milch verdampft, der Kochtopf brennt an.

rationale: Fills Preterit Intransitive 1 with a completed total-evaporation result, contrasting kfoyər in the same verse.

summary: The two milk forms at 56/123 distinguish ongoing kfoyər from resultant fayər kule after continued heating. Both fit existing sense 1 verdampfen; boiling and overflowing are supplied by neighboring predicates and do not warrant a new sense.
The speech-domain fuyarwo at 11/266 is the inherited sense 2 rasen in Infectum-wa. No evidence requires reassignment to fyr 1 'fly'.
No new collocation or Detransitive function is established.
In 56/123, can fyr itself include boiling over, or is evaporation the core meaning while kqoləb expresses overflowing? The current gloss is retained pending lexical evidence.
